report.summary: Patient P-D004 (Ernesto Villalobos, 51, Spanish-speaking) has commercial Employer PPO with no transport benefit. Single medication (losartan 25 mg daily, tier 1, $10/month copay, no refill gaps). Screener indicates transportation need ("no"). Home tract 17031610300 (Chicago, 60609): 25.1% of households no vehicle, 4 transit stops within 800m, low-income flag. Appointment at Clinic on 2026-10-19 at 16:00 (kept). Transit feasibility could not be confirmed because no facility location is on file for the appointment.

options.name: Community Pharmacy Assistance
options.how_to_access: Call for help applying for Extra Help and manufacturer copay programs. Eligible for current patients regardless of commercial plan.

options.name: Clinic Rx Fund
options.how_to_access: Short-term copay assistance for current patients; ask clinic social work/front desk to apply.

options.name: Paratransit Info Desk (ADA paratransit certification)
options.how_to_access: Apply by phone for ADA paratransit certification; decisions take up to 21 days. Eligibility depends on disability/functional ability, not insurance.

options.name: Medicaid Ride Line
options.how_to_access: Medicaid plan members only; call the number on the card at least 2 business days ahead. NOT eligible—patient has commercial insurance, no Medicaid.

options.name: Senior Shuttle West
options.how_to_access: Free weekday rides (7 AM–5 PM) for adults 60+ to medical appointments. NOT eligible—patient is 51.
